title: Cod Puttanesca with Broken Spaghetti
description: Frozen cod fillets poached in a one-pot puttanesca sauce of anchovies, tomatoes, olives and capers with broken spaghetti stirred through.
ingredients: 50g can anchovies in olive oil, fully drained
1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
1 tsp finely chopped rosemary leaves (plus extra to serve)
6 sage leaves, finely chopped (plus extra to serve)
250g dried spaghetti, strands broken into quarters
steps: Dab anchovies dry; roughly chop; fry in a large deep pan for 2 minutes with garlic and chilli, breaking up. No cooking spray needed.
Add oregano, rosemary and sage; stir-fry 30 seconds. Add tomatoes, tomato purée and water; bring to rapid simmer. Add broken spaghetti; stir to separate strands; add olives and capers.
Lay frozen cod on top; season; lid on; simmer 15 minutes.
Remove lid; shuffle pasta gently with a fork. Simmer 5 more minutes until spaghetti is al dente.
Serve immediately scattered with more rosemary and sage.
notes: If using fresh (not frozen) fish, add fillets with 6 minutes of cooking time remaining.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
